text.headline: Mean over 8-10 Hz and 1-2 mm tremor: ink error none 820 um, weighted 1014, pencil+AKF 666, Rev H+AKF as shipped 711, Rev H+AKF re-tuned 399, Rev H oracle 65; words read by the app 0.35 / 0.75 / 1.00 (none / Rev H re-tuned / oracle). At 4-6 Hz: none 829, Rev H re-tuned 832, oracle 49 um.
text.implication: The +-3 mm nose has the reach for 1-2 mm tremor; the tremor tracker, not the mechanism, limits the benefit, and it barely acts below about 6 Hz
text.weighted_headline: +60 g: ink error x1.24 at 8-10 Hz and x1.08 at 4-6 Hz vs the 12 g pen (1-2 mm); see et_sensitivity for the stiff-grip case
